events.title: Lexeo expands Friedreich ataxia platform with USD 21.3m Mantle acquisition and CNS collaborations
events.summary: Lexeo Therapeutics has agreed to acquire Mantle Therapeutics for up to $21.3 million, significantly expanding its Friedreich ataxia (FA) platform with four new frataxin-targeting programs, including oral and biologic therapies. This acquisition extends Lexeo's reach into CNS manifestations of FA, complementing its existing AAV gene therapy pipeline. Additionally, Lexeo announced three research collaborations to advance its lead AAV frataxin gene therapy, LX2006, focusing on sequential dosing and blood-brain barrier crossing technologies.

articles.headline: Lexeo expands Friedreich ataxia platform with USD 21.3m Mantle acquisition and CNS collaborations

events.title: PTC Therapeutics completes ST-920 gene therapy acquisition By Investing.com
events.summary: PTC Therapeutics has completed its acquisition of ST-920, a gene therapy for Fabry disease, from Sangamo Therapeutics, Inc. The company plans to submit a rolling Biologics License Application to the FDA for accelerated approval of ST-920 in the fourth quarter of 2026. ST-920 is a one-time administered AAV gene therapy that has received multiple designations from the FDA and European Medicines Agency, and is designed to address the limitations of chronic enzyme replacement therapy for Fabry disease.

articles.headline: PTC Therapeutics completes ST-920 gene therapy acquisition By Investing.com

events.title: Dominion-NextEra merger: SCC hears arguments on Clean Virginia motion to compel
events.summary: The State Corporation Commission (SCC) heard arguments regarding Clean Virginia's motion to compel NextEra to provide more information about its proposed $67 billion merger with Dominion Energy. Clean Virginia seeks documents related to alleged political misconduct and details on NextEra's past failed acquisition attempts, arguing this information is crucial for evaluating the merger's impact on Virginia ratepayers. NextEra claims these requests are irrelevant and would unnecessarily prolong the proceedings, while Clean Virginia insists a thorough examination is necessary before a decision is made.

articles.headline: Dominion-NextEra merger: SCC hears arguments on Clean Virginia motion to compel

events.title: LPL Financial, Northern Trust, Ameriprise Financial, Morgan Stanley, and Paymentus Stocks Trade Down, What You Need To Know

Despite the market's overreaction, these price drops could present buying opportunities for high-quality stocks.

events.title: The Clock Is Ticking on GameStop’s eBay Acquisition Play as Warrants Near Expiration
events.summary: GameStop has revealed a $4.9 billion stake in eBay and a proposed acquisition, detailed in its Q2 8-K filing. This development comes as 59 million GameStop warrants with a $32 strike price are set to expire on October 30, risking $1.9 billion in potential acquisition funding, as the current stock price is significantly lower at $22.76. The company's ability to fund this acquisition now largely depends on whether the stock can reach the strike price before the deadline or if alternative funding methods are secured.

events.title: Inflation Tops Family Offices’ Worries, Citi Survey Finds
events.summary: A recent survey by Citigroup Inc. reveals that inflation has become the primary concern for family offices globally, surpassing trade wars and tariffs. The report, based on surveys of 350 firms in over 40 countries, highlights that rising costs are now vexing even the wealthiest investors. Andy Sieg, head of Citi's New York-based bank, noted the significance of this shift in concern among successful individuals and families.

articles.headline: Inflation Tops Family Offices’ Worries, Citi Survey Finds
